code:
Same 20% APR farm, one year, starting at $10,000

Manual, claims monthly (n=12):
  value = 10,000 x (1 + 0.20/12)^12 ~= $12,194

Vault, harvests daily (n=365):
  value = 10,000 x (1 + 0.20/365)^365 ~= $12,213

Difference ~= $19/year on $10,000 -- before fees
caption: The vault doesn't invent yield -- it captures the compounding gap you'd otherwise leave on the table.

code:
pricePerShare = totalAssets / totalShares

Deposit 1,000 tokens @ pricePerShare = 1.00
  -> you receive 1,000 vault shares

After 6 months of harvesting:
  pricePerShare rises to 1.08

Withdrawal value = shares x pricePerShare
                  = 1,000 x 1.08 = 1,080 tokens
caption: You never "claim" along the way -- the share price itself embodies the compounding.
